artifact_observations.reasoning: The grid/checkered texture on the lower half appears slightly irregular and 'mushy' rather than having sharp, distinct mechanical edges, suggesting minor AI generation smoothing.
The geometry at the very top is ambiguous. The wind guard and nozzle area seem to merge indistinctly without clear mechanical separation or logical structural definition typical of real lighters.
The connection between the spark wheel and the main body lacks a clear axle or mounting point, appearing to float slightly or blend into the casing.
